scenarios.title: Standard Single Booking
scenarios.description: User provides all required information in a single, clear message.
scenarios.goal: Successfully initiate a reservation for a small party.
hidden_agendas: Include party size, date, time, and name in the initial greeting

scenarios.title: Out-of-Order Information Flow
scenarios.description: User provides the name and special request before specifying date or party size.
scenarios.goal: Verify the agent handles slot filling regardless of sequence.
hidden_agendas: Provide name and allergy info first
Wait for agent prompt to give date/time

scenarios.title: Large Party Credit Card Rule
scenarios.description: User attempts to book for 6 people to trigger the credit card requirement rule.
scenarios.goal: Test if the agent properly handles the large party constraints.
hidden_agendas: Request a party of 6
Inquire about the no-show fee policy

scenarios.title: Off-Hours Attempt
scenarios.description: User requests a time outside the 5 PM - 10 PM window.
scenarios.goal: Verify agent adheres to business hours rules.
hidden_agendas: Request a reservation for 3 PM

scenarios.title: The Drip-Feeder
scenarios.description: User provides only one piece of information per turn, forcing multiple turns.
scenarios.goal: Test system patience and conversational persistence.
hidden_agendas: Give only party size in first turn
Give date in second turn
Give time in third turn
Give name in fourth turn

scenarios.title: The Distracted Diner
scenarios.description: User asks multiple questions about the menu and directions before proceeding with the reservation.
scenarios.goal: Ensure the agent answers questions but successfully returns to the reservation flow.
hidden_agendas: Ask if the restaurant has gluten-free pasta
Ask for parking directions
Reluctantly proceed with the booking after being prompted

scenarios.title: The Impatient Booker
scenarios.description: User expresses frustration and demands to know if the reservation is confirmed.
scenarios.goal: Ensure the agent refuses to provide confirmation numbers while staying friendly.
hidden_agendas: Ask multiple times 'Are you sure it's confirmed?'
Demand a confirmation number

scenarios.title: Foreign Name Handling
scenarios.description: Test the agent's ability to handle complex or non-English names.
scenarios.goal: Verify the agent accepts varied name inputs without error.
hidden_agendas: Provide a long, hyphenated international name
Use a nickname instead of a formal name

scenarios.title: Minimalist Special Requests
scenarios.description: User explicitly states 'none' for special requests to satisfy that slot.
scenarios.goal: Verify the agent correctly flags the special request slot as closed.
hidden_agendas: Provide a specific date/time
Say 'none' when asked about special requirements

scenarios.title: Conversational Ambiguity
scenarios.description: User uses vague language (e.g., 'next Friday', 'around 7ish') to test slot interpretation.
scenarios.goal: Evaluate if the agent correctly resolves relative dates and imprecise times.
hidden_agendas: Use 'next Friday' instead of a calendar date
Use 'around 7ish' to test time normalization
